name: Super Times Pay
summary: A multiplier feature added to an ordinary base game. Judge the base paytable first — Super Times Pay only adds the multiplier on top.

facts.label: Cost
facts.value: A sixth coin per hand turns the feature on

facts.label: Multiplier
facts.value: Appears about once every 15 deals; average 4.05×

facts.label: Other base paytables
facts.value: Exact combined return not in the rulebook

facts.label: Variance
facts.value: Published as about 51% more standard deviation than the base game

facts.label: Strategy
facts.value: Play the base game's strategy; train on the base game tile

preserve.reason: Extra coin and bigger swings; only on a strong base paytable

state.reason: Multiplier is random each deal — nothing is left behind

rewards.reason: Six coins per hand raises coin-in; check total wager

practice.reason: Same strategy as the base game — train that instead
